anti_cheat: NPCs cannot react to facts they do not know.
Hidden events cannot be retroactively rewritten merely to surprise Jack.
The world does not auto-scale to Jack.
Offscreen resolution uses the same physical and rules constraints as on-screen play.
A result must have a causal path through state and events.

layers.BASELINE_TIMELINE: Expected world/NPC events absent Jack intervention; preserved separately.
layers.PLAYER_SAVE_OVERLAY: Jack-caused divergences, moved objects, injuries, deaths, rumors, relationships and other runtime changes.
layers.WORLD_BASE: Pre-existing physical/social world state. Player actions never rewrite this baseline.
